title: Demi-Vie
description: Seal the hatch on twelve survivors after a nuclear catastrophe. Carve rooms into the rock and reinforce them before they collapse. Keep the shelter supplied with air, water, food, and heat. Fetch what was left outside while the radiation halves, and prepare the Exodus.
controls: Left-click or tap to select, click and drag to mark out excavations
Use Undo last dig, Ctrl+Z or Command+Z to stop the latest unfinished excavation
Mouse wheel, trackpad pinch, or two fingers to zoom; one finger drags the map
WASD, ZQSD, or arrow keys to move the camera
Space to pause or resume, 1–5 to change speed: Live, Work, Watch, Hurry, Rush
A− and A+ to change the interface size; colours, language, and sound are in Options
